newsitem.title: USA: Mission West board declares distribution.
newsitem.headline: Mission West board declares distribution.

text.p: Mission West Properties board declared a $3.30 per share cash distribution to shareholders other than Berg & Berg Enterprises Inc and with a record date of August 28.

The American Stock Exchange said the shares will not trade ex-dividend until October 22 and shareholders selling shares between August 28 and the pay date of October 21 will transfer the right to get the distribution with the shares.

Shareholders approved the sale of six million shares of newly issued stock at $0.15 a share to the Berg Group. After closing, the company expects net assets of about $5.1 million consisting primarily of cash and cash equivalents.
